title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from eight patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital during pre-surgical monitoring. The dataset contains a 71-second ictal clip per patient and an interictal segment of up to about 2 hours per patient, sampled at 2000 Hz. These are the example data for the BrainQuake toolbox (Cai et al., 2022, Front. Neuroinform., doi:10.3389/fninf.2021.773890; a software paper cited as the toolbox reference), supporting epileptogenicity index and high-frequency event analyses. They are reorganised into iEEG-BIDS without signal processing.
methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Ictal clips (71 s) and interictal segments were exported as EDF/EDF+D files. Pre-implant T1 MRI and post-implant CT were acquired but are not redistributed. Interictal EDF annotations containing patient names were overwritten, and the signal data were left unchanged.
